purpose: Verified contract for material citizen notifications during a property legal-life investigation.
materiality_rule: Only citizen-relevant material state changes trigger notifications.
action_rule: Notifications state the minimum action required, or explicitly say when no action is needed.
privacy_rule: Restricted evidence and unnecessary personal information are excluded.
deadline_rule: No deadline or urgency is stated unless independently verified.
state_rule: Notification delivery is separate from the underlying investigation state.
change_rule: Answer changes identify whether they result from correction, new evidence, legal/procedural change or re-verification.
verification_boundary: Notifications communicate investigation state; they do not create or alter legal conclusions.
